ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

cards-grid.note: Cards compose a checkbox-style grid through a radio group: the group owns the single selected value.

color.note: The selected surface, border, and indicator follow the semantic color.

selection-card.description: Form control for selectable options with a card-sized target, radio and switch modes, media layouts, sizes, and states.

examples.note: A selectable option with supporting content. The native input covers the whole card surface.

installation.note: Install the Solaris UI package and import the selection card components.

media.note: Media renders full-width on top or as a side thumb at the start.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

selection.note: Radio cards belong to a radio group; switch cards are standalone boolean toggles rendered in the footer.

size-density.note: Size and density combine into a 3x3 matrix: density drives gap and padding, size drives the indicator, media thumb, and internal switch.

selection-card.title: Selection Card
